summary: editable-contracts@0.0.25 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at install
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) and then uses that dropped binary to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle using rotated string-array obfuscation and cryptic identifiers (WV8StW, hc1jfK9, MmgoCP, etDiOOB). The package advertises itself as a MobX helper for JSON-driven editable contracts and its distributed library code (`dist/editable-contracts.js`) does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or reference `math_init.js`. The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the advertised functionality, is not reachable from the library entry point, and is invoked only by the install-time dropper. The delivery pattern — fetch alternate runtime, then use it to execute a large opaque blob at `npm install` — is an alternate-runtime dropper that evades Node-based install scanners and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
